headline: Morocco Raises Electricity Value-Added Tax to 20% Under Tax Reform
summary: Morocco increased the VAT rate on electricity supply to the standard 20% rate effective January 1, while keeping end-consumer retail tariffs unchanged for households.
why: Tax rate adjustments on utility power impact fiscal revenues for North African governments while preserving consumer price caps.

impacts.name: Morocco
impacts.why: Higher standard VAT rates expand state fiscal collections from power utilities.
